page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn9gc-4x.32xlarge is an accelerated compute instance positioned within the Compute Optimized with GPU family. Operating on the KVM hypervisor and the x86_64 architecture, the platform is driven by an AMD EPYC 9A75 processor running at 3.3 GHz. The instance delivers 128 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 768 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 6.0 GB of RAM per vCPU core.

Hardware acceleration is supplied by four NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs offering a combined total of 288 GB of VRAM. Networking throughput is defined by a 128 Gbps baseline bandwidth, facilitating fast data exchange for multi-GPU training and high-volume data streams. The configuration does not include local storage, requiring network-attached storage solutions for persistent or scratch file operations, and includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From an infrastructure and cost perspective, ecs.gn9gc-4x.32xlarge concentrates substantial compute density, high memory capacity, and advanced acceleration into a single node. The architecture avoids the overhead of managing multiple smaller nodes for medium-to-large workloads, though workloads requiring localized ultra-low-latency disk I/O must account for external network storage dependencies. It is structured for deep learning model training, large language model inference, parallel scientific simulations, and distributed data analysis pipelines.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn9gc-4x.32xlarge is a high-density accelerated instance designed for compute-intensive workloads. Powered by an x86_64 AMD EPYC 9A75 processor clocked at 3.3 GHz, it features 128 dedicated vCPUs and 768 GB of system memory, yielding 6.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is provided by four NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs delivering 288 GB of aggregate VRAM. Networking capabilities feature a baseline bandwidth of 128 Gbps, supporting significant data transfer requirements for distributed computing. The instance includes no local storage or complimentary public IPv4 addresses, making network-attached block storage necessary for operational data persistence. Combining massive parallel GPU capability with high memory capacity, the ecs.gn9gc-4x.32xlarge is suited for distributed machine learning training, advanced artificial intelligence inference, high-performance computing, and parallel data analysis pipelines.
